hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: A line of parked cars on the right side of the street creates a visual barrier between pedestrians on the sidewalk and moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A wooden utility pole is located in the center of the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the clear path for pedestrians and creating a hazard for those with mobility aids or visual impairments.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the left curb block sightlines between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated path for pedestrians and reducing driver awareness of crossing activity.

hazards.name: Vehicle Encroachment
hazards.description: A white SUV is parked extremely close to the building, significantly narrowing the usable sidewalk width for pedestrians.
